ns2:course.label: Atomic Phys & Quantum Theory
ns2:course.description: (PHYCS 383) Introduction to the basic concepts of quantum theory which underlie modern theories of the properties of materials; topics covered include elements of atomic and nuclear theory; kinetic theory and statistical mechanics; quantum theory and simple applications; atomic spectra and atomic structure; molecular structure and chemical binding. Lectures and problems. Prerequisite: CHEM 104; PHYS 114; MATH 385 or equivalent.
